name: Sit-Down Lunch New Orleans Muffuletta Sandwich with Chips
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Aged provolone cheese and mortadella are lactose-safe, but sesame-crusted bread, fatty salami, and briny olive-giardiniera salad are rough.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the sandwich made without the chopped olive/pickled vegetable salad and swap sesame bread for plain white bread.
watchOuts: Chopped olive and pickled giardiniera relish
Sesame seeds on muffuletta loaf and cured salami fat
